name: Denominator and external source bridge candidates (nonclaim)

bridges.source_name: DOJ Civil Rights Division Special Litigation Section Cases and Matters — Law Enforcement Agencies section
bridges.source_owner: U.S. Department of Justice Civil Rights Division
bridges.source_role: official accountability matter/document-carrier source, not denominator source
what_it_can_support: existence of official DOJ matter rows and linked document labels at observation time
bridges.freshness_caveat: source page updated label preserved, not treated as current status proof

bridges.source_name: BJS Census of State and Local Law Enforcement Agencies (CSLLEA) data collection page
what_it_cannot_support: current post-2018 agency existence without update
bridges.freshness_caveat: 2018 is a reference-date source; 2022 CSLLEA is tracked as a freshness watch until ingested

bridges.source_name: BJS Census of State and Local Law Enforcement Agencies, 2018 – Statistical Tables
bridges.source_role: published 2018 denominator and agency-type summary source
bridges.freshness_caveat: statistical table values are reference-date data and must be displayed as such

bridges.source_name: BJS forthcoming-publications watch for Census of State and Local Law Enforcement Agencies, 2022
bridges.source_role: freshness watch, not a denominator source until publication/dataset accession
what_it_can_support: reminder that 2018 CSLLEA may be superseded
bridges.freshness_caveat: must recheck before using 2018 as latest available denominator source

bridges.source_name: ICPSR/NACJD Law Enforcement Agency Identifiers Crosswalk (LEAIC)
bridges.source_owner: ICPSR/National Archive of Criminal Justice Data
bridges.source_role: crosswalk candidate for ORI, FIPS, Census government IDs, and place-level linkage
bridges.freshness_caveat: crosswalk version/reference year must be pinned before match

bridges.source_name: FBI Crime Data Explorer / UCR public agency surfaces
bridges.source_role: possible ORI/reporting-agency public surface and UCR participation context
bridges.freshness_caveat: FBI surfaces vary by collection and reporting period

bridges.source_role: aggregate/participation context source with strong caveats; not incident/legal-status source
what_it_cannot_support: specific incident details in public display
bridges.freshness_caveat: participation and releases must be time-pinned

bridges.source_owner: International Association of Directors of Law Enforcement Standards and Training
bridges.source_role: person-level certification/license revocation registry pointer; not an agency denominator source
what_it_cannot_support: public officer record creation in this revision
misconduct finding outside reported revocation action
bridges.freshness_caveat: access and participation constraints require separate policy before use
